full_details: You sat, because the back would allow nothing else after yesterday. You went over the orchard scene for the stage it will be played on, not the garden it was written in. Twelve feet and a gallery rail. A boy on the boards, a girl above, no grand architecture, the Nurse's voice from behind the arras. The hurry is the house waking behind her, not anything a carpenter could build. You cut four lines of the boy's that admired the window. A neighbour's voice came in at your casement, scolding a prentice. You shut it, and at once you missed the air. The sheet has a square for the window, an arrow for the Nurse, and your hand flat beside it. At two you were Egeon again. At night you put Friday's Rose bill in the almanac, and under it the yard.
one_sentence: You sat to the orchard scene, cut four lines that admired the window, shut the casement on a neighbour, and played Egeon at two.
title: The stage orchard, twelve feet and a rail
